user.description: The device must already be on your Wi-Fi: set it up with the EWPE Smart app first. Give it a fixed address in your router.

data_description.host: The device's IPv4 address. Leave it empty to search your network.

pick_device.description: Dehumidifiers that answered the search and are not added yet.

data_description.mac: IP address and MAC address: your router lists both.

data_description.host: The device's IPv4 address on your network.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from this address on UDP port 7000. Check the address, and that the device is on and answers locally.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address: four numbers separated by dots.
error.port_closed: The device at this address refused UDP port 7000. Check the address: it may be another device. A Gree module that refuses this port cannot be controlled locally.
error.no_devices_found: No new dehumidifier answered the search. Check that it is on, or enter its IP address: the search does not reach other subnets.

abort.already_configured: This device is already added; its address was updated.
abort.already_in_progress: This device is already being set up.
abort.not_dehumidifier: This device (MID {mid}) is not a dehumidifier. Gree air conditioners work with the built-in Gree Climate integration.
abort.unsupported_model: This dehumidifier model (MID {mid}, variant {vender}) is not supported.
abort.wrong_device: Another device answers at this address.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the device's state is read, 15 to 300 seconds. After a command the state is also read 2 seconds later.

no_answer.message: No answer from the device at {host}.

locked.message: This can't be changed in the {mode} mode.

tank_full.message: This can't be changed while the water tank is full.

humidity_out_of_range.message: The target humidity must be from {min} to {max} %, not {humidity} %.

unsupported_model.message: This version does not support the model with MID {mid}.

set_state.name: Set state
set_state.description: Sets several things in one command, so the dehumidifier beeps once: any of power, mode, target humidity and fan speed. The panel's rules hold for the mode the command sets.

power.name: Power
power.description: On or off. The other settings of the command are applied first, so it turns on with them.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Dry and Purify have no target humidity; Dry keeps the fan at High.

fan_speed.name: Fan speed
fan_speed.description: Not in Dry, which keeps the fan at High.
